title: Past Perfect / Isiphephile (isiphephile sasekhona)
bridge: NesiNgisi, isiphephile (had eaten) isebenza njengokwenza umsebenzi ophelele kwakhona ngaphambi kwesiphephile esikade. Kulo Mzansi, isiphephile (había comido) isebenza kangakanani, kodwa kunezimbuzo eziqakathekile: isiphephile saseNgisi sihlobene ngokufanayo (kufika 'had + participio'), futhi kulo Mzansi sihlobane ngokufanayo nge-'already', 'just', 'never' ukuze kukhombise isiphephile. Khathalela: kulo Mzansi, ngenkathi sihlobene isiphephile (comí) lapho isiphephile saseNgisi siyadinga isiphephile (had eaten) lapho kukhona umsebenzi ophelele kwakhona. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kulo Mzansi isiphephile sihlinzeka ngokuhloba isikhathi 'haber', kodwa kulo Ngisi 'had' ayihambisani nakho yonke into.
rule: Isiphephile sihlinzeka ngokuhloba 'had' (nakho yonke into) + isiphephile sasekhona saso somsebenzi oqakathekile. Sihlobene ukuze kukhombise umsebenzi owenzile kwakhona ngaphambi kwesiphephile esikade, ngamunye 'isiphephile sasekhona'. Emizuzweni eyiphambanayo: umuntu + had + isiphephile. Ezinjengiyeni: had not (hadn't) + isiphephile. Emibuzweni: Had + umuntu + isiphephile. Sihlobene ngezikhathi ezijwayelekile njengokuba 'already', 'just', 'never', 'ever', 'by the time', 'before', 'after'. Izibonelo: 'I had finished my homework before dinner' (había terminado mi tarea antes de la cena). Sihlobene nalo ukuze kukhombise isiphephile sasekhona (present perfect -> past perfect). Isikhalo: kulo Ngisi nge-'after' futhi 'before' ngenkathi kukhona isiphephile esikade lapho isiphephile sasekhona sikhombisa ngokucacile, kodwa isiphephile sasekhona sikhombisa ngokucacile. Khathalela: kulo Mzansi isiphephile sihlobene ngokufanayo; kulo Ngisi sihlobene ngokufanayo ezindikimeni ukuze kukhombise isiphephile sasekhona.

title: Conditionals Type 1 and 2 / Izingxoxo zezimo 1 ne-2
bridge: NesiNgisi, siyaxhomekisa isikhathi esihambisana nge-if kwi-clause yokuxhoma futhi siyaxhomekisa isikhathi esizayo nge-'will' kwi-clause elibalulekile (If I have time, I will go). Kwi-conditionals, isikhathi esihambisana siyasebenza kwi-clause elibalulekile, futhi 'would' + infinitive siyasebenza kwi-clause yokuxhoma. Qaphela: kwi-conditionals, isikhathi esidlule siyasebenza ukuxhoma umqondo ongenalutho nge-present noma isikhathi esizayo, hhayi ukudlulisa isikhathi. Ungakhathazeki ukudlulisa ngokungaphezulu kusiNgisi, ngenxa yokuthi izinhlelo ziyantya.
rule: I-conditional lokuqala (isimo 1) liyasetshenziswa ezimo ezinjengesikhashana noma ezinakeleka ngosuku lwangakubo noma esizayo. Liqalwe ng: If + umakhelwane + isikhathi esihambisana, + umakhelwane + will + isikhathi esisodwa. Isibonelo: If it rains, we will stay at home. I-clause ye-if ingahamba phambili noma phakathi, futhi uma ihamba phambili, isehluleka ngenhlanhla. Ngezinye izikhathi, 'unless' (ngaphandle uma) ingasetshenziswa esikhundleni se-'if not'. I-conditional lwesibili (isimo 2) liyasetshenziswa ezimo ezingena lutho, ezingenalutho noma ezingenalutho ngosuku lwangakubo noma esizayo. Liqalwe ng: If + umakhelwane + isikhathi esidlule, + umakhelwane + would + isikhathi esisodwa. Isibonelo: If I had more money, I would travel. Kwi-conditional lwesibili, 'to be' liyasetshenziswa nge-'were' kubo bonke abantu (If I were...). 'Was' aliyasetshenziswa ezinye izikhathi, kodwa kwi-English engahlulwa, ngokuvamile liyasetshenziswa. 'Could' noma 'might' ngezinye izikhathi liyasetshenziswa esikhundleni se-'would' ukudonsa ukunakeleka noma ukwazi. I-conditional lwesibili liyasetshenziswa ukunika izilathiso ('If I were you, I would...') futhi ukudonsa izifiso ezingenalutho.

title: Passive Voice: Present & Past / Izwi elingavavi: esikhathi samanje nalokhu lwedlu
bridge: Ngesi, izwi elingavavi lyakhiwa ngokushwa 'be' + umthelela, njengenkathi yisiNgisi (to be + past participle). Nokho, ngesi umphumela wenguquko usungulwa ngokuthi 'by', ngakho-ke ngesi sisebenzisa 'by'. Ngaphandle kwalokho, ngesi isikhumbuzi sendaba elingavavi ithathwe ngokukhulu kunespi, lapho kunzima ukusetshenziswa kwesandi esivulekile noma esivulekile ('se'). Umphutha othwala ngokufutha ukushiya isandi 'to be' noma ukucaphukisa umbhalo wemthelela odlule.
rule: Izwi elingavavi lwakhiwa ngokushwa isandi 'to be' ngesikhathi esifanelekileyo (esikhathi samanje: am/is/are; esikhathi edlule: was/were) + umthelela wesandi esikhulu. Indaba yesandi esivulekile iya emuva ngokuba yisikhumbuzi sendaba ngokuthi 'by' (nakhu okungase kushiywe uma akusikhombisa). Ukwenza okuvaviwe, into eyodwa yesandi esivulekile iya phambili. Izibonelo: Esivulekile: 'The chef cooks the meal' → Okuvaviwe: 'The meal is cooked by the chef'. Ngesikhathi samanje, sisebenzisa 'is/are' ngokwendaba (singular/plural). Ngesikhathi edlule, 'was/were'. Umthelela wesandi esikhulu yisibonelo esitathu sesandi (okomthetho: -ed; okungalokomthetho: uhlu). Iziphakamiso: akusetshenziswa okuvaviwe ngezimiselo ezingasengeni (azingenayo into eyodwa). Ukufaka ngezimiselo: lapho inguquko ayiziqondiwe, okubiliwe noma okuningi kakhulu kunesekwa.

title: Reported Speech / Isiboniso esingaphakathi esisodwa
bridge: NgesisiZulu, lapho sihambisa kwisiboniso esingaphakathi, siyaguqula izikhathi zeverb (ngokwesibonelo, 'wathi wayelambile'), kanti ngeEnglish kude kwenzeka okuthanda kunalokho kodwa kuneziyaluze ezingeze: amazwi esikhathi lamazwi endaweni (namuhla→ngalolosuku, lapha→khona) nokuhlela kwamazwi. Umphutha othile ngokuthi uhlala esikhathini somsebenzi wesifiso (wathi: 'Ngiyagijima' → *Wathi wayengijimanga), kodwa ngeEnglish B1 kuhlehlwa 'ukubuyisela emuva': 'Wathi wayengijimanga'. Inye idivayisi yikuthi ngeEnglish awusetshenzwa isiqupiso 'that' ngokomthetho (ungasho 'Wathi wayengijimanga' okanye 'Wathi ukuthi wayengijimanga'), ngakho-ke ngeZulu 'ukuthi' kudingeka.
rule: Isiboniso esingaphakathi sisetshenziswa ukubika okwashiwo ngumuntu. NgeEnglish, isiboniso esiqalayo sithile ngokuthi 'say' okanye 'tell'. 'Say' aliyithathi into eyodwa (Wathi wayehlezi), ngakho-ke 'tell' ithatha into eyodwa (Wathi wam ngokuthi wayehlezi). Ukuhlaziywa okukhulu: 1) Izikhathi zeverb (namuhla→ngezansi, ngesikhathi→ngezansi): 'Ngiyagijima' → 'wayengijimanga', 'Ngiyagijima' → 'wayengijimanga'. 2) Amazwi esikhathi: 'Ngiyagijima' → 'wayengijimanga', 'ngiyakwethu' → 'wayengijimanga'. 3) Amazwi esikhathi: 'namuhla'→'ngalolosuku', 'kusasa'→'ngosuku olulandelayo', 'izolo'→'ngosuku oludlule'. 4) Indawo: 'lapa'→'khona'. Izibopho: uma umsebenzi usakhela okuthile okusodwa okanye isikhathi asihambile, ungahlela isikhathi esisodwa (Wathi wayengijimanga - uma usakhela ukuthi wayengijimanga). Ngokubuzwa, kushiywa 'if' okanye 'whether' ngokuthi yini/cha, lamazwi okubuzwa ngokubuzwa okukhululekile, kuhlela kwebuzo (Wathi wam ngokuthi ngiphila phi, cha 'ngiphila phi'). Ngokubuzwa/ukubuzwa, kushiywa 'tell/ask + umuntu + to + infinitive' (Wathi wam ukuthi ngihleke).

title: Gerunds and Infinitives as Subject and Object / I-Gerund nakanye I-Infinitive njengesikhumbuzi nenkathalo
bridge: NgisiZulu, siyasetshenzisa i-infinitive njengesikhumbuzi nakanye emva kwama-verbs amanengi (ngokomfano, 'ukoyisa kunjabulo', 'ngiyakuthanda ukoyisa'). NgesiNgisi, isimo siyahlukile: ngemarhu ayo siyasetshenzisa i-gerund (-ing) nakanye i-infinitive (to + verb). Umthelela oqondene nguwosithi lapho isenzo isikhumbuzi sesihlokwana nenkathalo kwama-verbs amaningi njengokuthi 'enjoy' okanye 'finish', siyasetshenzisa i-gerund. Nema-verbs ezinye njengokuthi 'want' okanye 'decide', siyasetshenzisa i-infinitive. Le yisashalazane esikhulu kuma-Spanish speakers ngenxa yokuthi akukho ubudlelane obudlula ngokubalulekile.
rule: NgesiNgisi, kunezindlela ezimbili ezingaphandle komkhiqizo we-verb: i-gerund (verb + -ing) ne-infinitive (to + umcqsho wokuqala). Njengesikhumbuzi sesihlokwana, i-gerund iyindlela ephanekayo nenhlala (ngokomfano, 'Ukoyisa kunjabulo'). Njenkathalo, ukhetha kuhlala kuma-verbs amakhulu: ezinye i-verbs azamiswa ne-gerund (enjoy, finish, avoid, suggest, consider), ezinye ne-infinitive (want, need, decide, hope, plan). Ezinye i-verbs zishinta umthelela ngokwetshenziswa kwazo (njengokuthi 'stop' okanye 'remember'). Kuma-B1 students, kuxhokonisa ukukhumbula amalista ama-verbs amanengi nokusebenzisa ngemifano. Kuyabalulekile ukubona ukuthi ngesiNgisi, i-infinitive ayisetshenziswa njengesikhumbuzi njengoba kuseziZulu; i-gerund okanye isakhiwo 'it is + adjective + to + verb' siyakuthandeka.

title: Modal Verbs for Deduction / Izi-modal zokudeda (must, might, could)
bridge: NgisiZulu, sisebenzisa 'kufanele' ukudeda enezisekelo ephakeme, 'mhlawe' ukuba kune okunokuba, futhi 'kungenzeka' ukuba kune okungcono. Nokho, ngesiNgisi kune udabaniso olukhulu: izi-modal azichazwa futhi azithathi 'to'. Udaba oluluyavelele ngokubanzi yikuthi ngisiZulu sasebenzisa isikhathi esizayo ('sizokuba') ukudeda, kodwa ngesiNgisi sisebenzisa 'must' + isifundo sasebusweni. Lokhu kungakwambambise uma uguqule ngokungaphezulu. Khumbula: ngesiNgisi, ukudeda kuboniswa ngesimodi + isifundo sasebusweni, ngaphandle kwesethu 'to', futhi umwebo wengalo ngu-subject + modal + verb.
rule:
NgesiNgisi, ukwenza izidedo ngokwamuhla sisebenzisa 'must', 'might' futhi 'could'. 
- **Must** + isifundo sasebusweni: bika ukudeda enezisekelo ephakeme (ulwazi, ubufakazi obukhulu). Lungane ne 'kufanele' ngisiZulu. Isibonelo: 'She must be at home' (Kufanele abe ekhaya). 
- **Might** + isifundo sasebusweni: bika ukunokuba, ukungazi. Lungane ne 'mhlawe' noma 'mhlawumbe'. Isibonelo: 'He might be sick' (Mhlawe ugula). 
- **Could** + isifundo sasebusweni: nabo bika ukunokuba, kodwa ngenkathi izinzile zisebenzisa ukubeka ukuthi kune okunokuba, kodwa akukho okunokuba. Lungane ne 'kungenzeka'. Isibonelo: 'It could rain today' (Kungenzeka kuhle kusalayo). 

**Izinhlelo:** izi-modal aziguquli njengomuntu (akwasekho '-s' ne-he/she/it). Azithathi 'to' emva kwazo. Ukungavumelani 'must' ukudeda kungukuthi 'can't' (hhayi 'mustn't'): 'She can't be at work' (Akunakuba emsebenzini). 

**Isibambo:** zisebenzisa ukudeda izidedo eziyisekhona. Ukudeda ngokomlando, sisebenzisa 'must have + participio', 'might have + participio', njalo, kodwa lokhu kukhulu kakhulu kune B1. 

**Izinkombiso:** akusebenzisiwe 'must' ukubuzwa izibalo zokudeda; kanti kusebenziswa 'Do you think...' noma umwebo wezubuzo no- 'be' noma amazwi amanye.

title: Relative Clauses: Defining vs. Non-Defining / Iziga zokubeka ngezindaba: Okubekayo nokusebenzisa
bridge: Ngesi, iziga zokubeka ngezindaba nezokushicilela zihlukaniswa ngokuvuna: izokushicilela zinevuna. NgesiNgisi, ngaphandle kovuna, isibonelo sokuqukethwe sikhashana: 'that' seisetshenziswa kuphela ezokubekayo (nje ingabe ingavunyelwa), ngakho-ke 'which/who' ezokushicilela ngisho nje zisukelwa yizivuna. Qaphela: ngesiNgisi awunakusebenzisa 'that' ezokushicilela.
rule: Iziga zokubeka ngezindaba (zibeka umuntu noma into esithini esikhuluma ngaso) azinevuna nje ingabe zisetshenziswa 'that' noma 'who/which'. Nendlela engasemo, 'that' (noma isibonelo njengokuba yisikhathi) ingavunyelwa: 'The book (that) I bought'. Izokushicilela (zongeza ulwazi olungeziwe) ngisho nje zisukelwa yizivuna nezokushicilela kuphela zisetshenziswa 'who' abantu no 'which' into, ngisho nje 'that'. Izibonelo azinakuvunyelwa ezokushicilela. Izibonelo: Okubekayo: 'The woman who lives next door is a doctor.' (Umama osemncane uyisilisa). Okungabeki: 'My sister, who lives in Madrid, is a doctor.' (Udade wami, osemncane, uyisilisa).

title: Wish + past / Ukunqwenela ukuze phathise izifiso ezingenamthelela
bridge: Ngesi, siyaxalisa 'wish' nekhanda lasekhono elidlule (liphula noma eliphelele) ukuze sicace ukuthi isimo asiyikwazi ngoku noma ayikwazi ngokwenyezelo. Umphutha ongenelela yindlela esebenzisa isikhathi samanje noma ukuxhumana ('I wish I have...' noma 'I wish I would have...'), okuthunyelwe lulelu kaliSpani. Khumbula: ipheli ngeNgisi lapha ayicacisi isikhathi, kodwa ukungenamthelela.
rule: Umbungazi omkhulu uya kuba: **wish + umphathi + isikhathi esedlule esiphula** ukuze sifisele izifiso ngoku (izimo ezingenamthelela noma ezihamba phambili). Ngokwesibonelo: 'I wish I knew the answer' (Angiyikwazi). Ukuphatha isifiso ngokudlule (into engakwenzekanga), siyaxalisa **wish + ipheli elidlule eliphelele** ('I wish I had studied more'). Asisebenzisi 'would' emva kuka 'wish' uma umphathi unguye (I wish I would... ayisebenzi); siyaxalisa 'would' nje ukuze sikhombise noma sifisele izifiso ngokwenzeka kwabanye (I wish you would stop). Nge 'wish' + 'were' kuhlanganisiwe njengokuthi 'was' (nakhu 'was' kukhulunywa ngeNgisi engasemi). Khumbula ukuthi 'wish' iveza ukubuyela emuva noma ukuxhalabelana; ukuze ufisele izifiso eziyenzekako, sebenzisa 'hope' (I hope you come).

title: Used to / Ukudonsa izindlela zakudala
bridge: Ngesi, siyahlala siqukethe ‘used to’ + isifundo sokuzenza (I used to, she used to) ukudonsa izindlela zakudala. Okungaphambanayo nokusebenzisa isikhathi sokuqala (‘jugaba’) ngesiporutugi. ‘Used to’ yisimo esifanelekile esikho nje ngesikhathi esidlulile futhi aliyahluleki ngabantu. Iphutha elithile kakhulu ngokudonsa ‘used to’ no ‘be used to’ (ukuba noma yini) noma ‘use to’ emaphuzweni nakwesizindlondweni. Khumbula ukuthi emaphuzweni nakwesizindlondweni siyasho ‘didn't use to’ ne ‘Did you use to?’.
rule: ‘Used to’ siyasebenzisa ukudonsa izindlela noma izimo zakudala ezazingasekho namuhla. Ukuqambelela kwayo kunjalo: umqondo + used to + isifundo sokuzenza. Akukho ngesikhathi esiza noma esizayo; ngesikhathi esiza siyasebenzisa ‘usually’ + isifundo sokuzenza ngesikhathi esiza. Emaphuzweni: didn't use to + isifundo sokuzenza. Esizindlondweni: Did + umqondo + use to + isifundo sokuzenza? (ngaphandle kwa -d). Qaphela: asisho ‘I use to’ ukudonsa isikhathi esidlulile, futhi ‘used to’ aliyidonsa -ed ngesikhathi esidlulile ngenxa yokuthi uyisikhathi esidlulile. Kunanoma ‘would’ ukudonsa izindlela zakudala, kodwa nje ngokwenzeka, hhayi ngezimo.

title: Purpose, Cause and Result / Isimo, Isizathu, Nesiphetho
bridge: NgesiSpani, siyahlela ukusebenzisa 'para que' kuisimo nokusebenzisa 'porque' ekusizatheni, ngakabe nge-English siyasebenza 'so that' ne-'because (of)'. Uhlobo olukhulu lwendondakalo yikuthi 'so that' ngisho nekhona isetshenziswa ngemibhalo (umxhwezo + isicwangciso), ngakabe 'because of' isetshenziswa ngemibhalo. Ngaphambi kwezo zinto, nge-English siyasebenza 'so' (ngaphandle kuka-'that') ukuze sicaphise isiphetho, okuNgesiSpani kungaba yikuthi 'así que' okanye 'por lo tanto'.
rule:
Ukuze ucaphise isimo, isizathu, nesiphetho nge-English, siyasebenza izinhlelo ezilandelayo:
- **Isimo:** 'so that' (para que) + umxhwezo omene isicwangciso somthelela (can, could, will, would) okanye isicwangciso sasekhaya. Isibonelo: 'I study so that I can pass the exam.' Ngezinye izikhathi siyasebenza 'in order to' (para) + infinitive, kodwa lolu hlobo luyafana nokuba luhlobo olucacileyo.
- **Isizathu:** 'because' (porque) + umxhwezo, okanye 'because of' (debido a) + igama okanye isihloko. Isibonelo: 'She stayed home because she was sick' (umxhwezo) vs. 'She stayed home because of the rain' (igama).
- **Isiphetho:** 'so' (así que) + umxhwezo wesiphetho. Isibonelo: 'It was raining, so we stayed home.' Ngezinye izikhathi siyasebenza 'therefore' (por lo tanto) emacansini acacileyo.
- **Ukuphikisana neNgesiSpani:** NgesiSpani, 'para que' iyadinga isicwangciso somthelela ('para que estudies'), ngakabe nge-English siyasebenza isicwangciso sasekhaya (ngokuvamile kune-'can' okanye 'could'). Ungafanisi 'so' (isiphetho) no-'so that' (isimo).

title: Common Phrasal Verbs / Amavhesi Omshumayela Abaningi
bridge: Ngesi, amavhesi amaningi aveza umsebenzi oqedisiwe ngeyezindaba elilodwa (ngokwesibonelo, 'ukuphakama', 'ukuzonda'), kodwa ngesiPhuzulu, amavhesi omshumayela ahlanganisa isivumelwano nesiphumo (up, down, off, etc.) eshintsha okanye esonga umthelezelo waso. Ngokwesibonelo, 'ukuphakama' akusiyo 'ukufinyelela phezulu', kodwa 'ukuphakama'. Inkinga esiyinhloko iyakuthi lawa miphumo ayihunyushwa ngokwenhloso, kanti, kwimavhesi omshumayela abahlanganiswa, into ebekho (igama lesibonelo okanye igama lomuntu) ingahlekelwa phakathi kwesivumelwano nesiphumo ('shaya i-TV off' okanye 'shaya off i-TV'), okungaba yinto engasoze ifanele ngesiPhuzulu.
rule: Isivumelwano somshumayelo siyihlanganiso yomshumayeli nomshumayeli okanye isigaba (siphumo). Umthelezelo wohlanganiso ngokuvamile awududuzwa kwizindaba ngokwahlulelane. Ngakho-ke, kufanele fundwe njengamagangatho wokufunda. Kunezindabe eziyi-2 ezinhloko: ezihamba njengabanye nalezinhloko. Ezihamba njengabanye zingaba zihlanganiswe okanye zingahlanganiswa. Ezihlanganisweni, into ebekho (igama lesibonelo okanye igama lomuntu) ingahlekelwa phakathi kwesivumelwano nesiphumo, kodwa uma into ebekho yisigama somuntu (it, them, etc.), kufanele yohlekelwa phakathi kwazo ngokungaqhubekayo: 'shaya it off' (hhayi 'shaya off it'). Ezinjengabanye, into ebekho ngokuvamile iya emva kwesiphumo: 'khangela emva kwabantwana' (hhayi 'khangela abantwana emva'). Ezinye izivumelwano zomshumayelo zingahambi njengabanye futhi azinikezi into ebekho ngokwenye: 'vuka', 'khula'. Kuyabalulekile ukukhumbula indawo efanelekile nomthelezelo ngokwesiqotho. Ngokwe-B1, ezinjengezi: ukuphakama, ukuvuka, ukuvula/ukuzonda, ukufaka, ukususa, ukucinga, ukukhangela, ukufumana, ukushiya, ukuya, ukubuya, njll.

title: Advanced Quantifiers / Iziqili ezikhulunywa kabanzi
bridge: NgesiSpani, siyaxalisa 'pocos', 'bastantes', 'casi ningún' ukuze sicazise isilinganiso, kodwa ngesiNgisi la madiba asebenziselwa kuhlu lukhulu lwezikhalo ezahlukahlukene nezazi zokubala/zokungabalwa. Isiqingatha esikhulu yikuthi 'hardly any' no 'plenty of' asinazo iziphendlele ezisodwa: 'hardly any' yodwa 'casi' no 'ninguno', ngakabe 'plenty of' ishoko 'más que suficiente', hhayi 'mucho'. Ngaphezu kwalokho, khumbula ukuthi 'plenty of' isetshenziselwa kuphela emiqaleni, hhayi emibuyekezo noma emibuzweni, ngokungalungisi 'much/many'.
rule: Iziqili ezikhulunywa kabanzi ngesiNgisi (B1) zifaka: 'hardly any' (casi ningún/ninguno) zisetshenziselwa nezikhalo eziqondile eziqondile nezokungabalwa, futhi inhloso yaso ingamukeleki (isodwa 'very few' noma 'very little'). 'Plenty of' (bastante, más que suficiente) isetshenziselwa emiqaleni emiqaleni nezikhalo eziqondile eziqondile nezokungabalwa (hhayi emibuzweni no 'any' noma emibuyekezo). Ezinye iziqili: 'a good deal of' (bastante, okomthetho, nezokungabalwa), 'a large amount of' (una gran cantidad de, nezokungabalwa), 'a large number of' (un gran número de, nezokubala), 'a couple of' (un par de, nezokubala). Qaphela: 'plenty of' iselula isikhalo noma umlomo, hhayi isiboniso. 'Hardly any' siyekela phambi kwesikhalo futhi ngokuthe nyana isetshenziselwa no 'there is/are'. Emibuzweni nemibuyekezo, kukhona ukuthanda 'much' noma 'many' esikhundleni 'plenty'.

common_error.correct: There are plenty of people at the party.
common_error.correct_alt: The party has plenty of people.
common_error.explanation: Isiphambano ngokusebenzisa isigaba 'in' esikhundleni 'at' lapho sikhuluma ngesihloko sesikhungu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abafundi abanye basetshenzisa 'plenty of' emibuzweni noma emibuyekezo (ngokwesibonelo 'Do you have plenty of money?'), kodwa lapho kukhona ukuthi kukhulunywa ngokwengezi 'much' noma 'many' (Do you have much money?). Khumbula: 'plenty of' iyodwa emiqaleni, futhi emiholweni noma emibuzweni kukhona ukusetshenziswa 'much' nezokungabalwa no 'many' nezokubala.

examples.original: There were hardly any students in class today.
examples.phonetic: /ðeər wɜːr ˈhɑːrdli ˈeni ˈstjuːdənts ɪn klɑːs təˈdeɪ/
examples.note: Kusetshenziselwa 'hardly any' nezikhalo eziqondile eziqondile; isodwa 'very few'. Umlomo 'were' uyiqondile ngoba isikhalo siyiqondile.

examples.original: I have hardly any money.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ˈhɑːrdli ˈeni ˈmʌni/
examples.note: Nezokungabalwa (money) kusenokwenzeka 'hardly any'. NgisiSpani sicela 'casi nada de', kodwa ngesiNgisi awusetshenziselwa 'nothing' lapha.

examples.original: She had hardly any time to prepare.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː hæd ˈhɑːrdli ˈeni taɪm tə prɪˈpɛr/
examples.note: Khumbula ukuthi 'hardly any' ineenglerisha engamukelekile; awusetshenziselwa 'not' ngaphandle.

examples.original: Don't worry, we have plenty of food for everyone.
examples.phonetic: /doʊnt ˈwɜːri wi hæv ˈplɛnti əv fuːd fɔːr ˈɛvriwʌn/
examples.note: 'Plenty of' isetshenziselwa emiqaleni futhi ishoko 'más que suficiente'. Nezokungabalwa njengokudla.

examples.original: There are plenty of books on that shelf.
examples.phonetic: /ðeər ɑːr ˈplɛnti əv bʊks ɒn ðæt ʃɛlf/
examples.note: Nezikhalo eziqondile eziqondile, 'plenty of' iyoluwa; ngisiSpani ngokuthe nyana siyiguqula njengokuthi 'muchos', kodwa ingqalelo yengqalelo yokuqinisekiswa.

examples.original: We had plenty of opportunities to practice.
examples.phonetic: /wi hæd ˈplɛnti əv ˌɒpərˈtjuːnɪtiz tə ˈpræktɪs/
examples.note: Kusenokwenzeka ukuguqula njengokuthi 'de sobra' ukuze sicazise ukubamba okuningi. Awusetshenziselwa 'plenty of' emibuzweni noma emibuyekezo.

levels.label: Large quantities: a large number of / a large amount of
levels.translation: Izilinganiso ezikhulu: un gran número de / una gran cantidad de

examples.original: A large number of tourists visit this city every year.
examples.phonetic: /ə lɑːrdʒ ˈnʌmbər əv ˈtʊərɪsts ˈvɪzɪt ðɪs ˈsɪti ˈɛvri jɪər/
examples.translation: Abahambi abaningi baya kulesi city ngonyaka.
examples.note: Kusetshenziselwa 'a large number of' nezikhalo eziqondile eziqondile (tourists).

examples.original: The factory produces a large amount of waste.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈfæktəri prəˈdjuːsɪz ə lɑːrdʒ əˈmaʊnt əv weɪst/
examples.note: Nezikhalo eziqondile eziqondile (waste), kusetshenziselwa 'a large amount of'.

examples.original: She spends a good deal of time on her homework.
examples.phonetic: /ʃi spɛndz ə gʊd diːl əv taɪm ɒn hɜːr ˈhoʊmwɜːrk/
examples.note: 'A good deal of' iyoluwa kabanzi futhi isetshenziselwa nezokungabalwa (time). Isodwa 'a lot of' kodwa aluhlaza.

title: Verb patterns: verb + infinitive / gerund / Izibonelo zezikhombisi: isikhombisi + infinitive / gerund
bridge: Ngesisi, emva kwesikhombisi esingumsuka, siyathusa ukusebenzisa infinitive (ok., 'ngithanda ukudla', 'ngiyekela ukukhuluma'). Nokho, ngesiNgisi, ezinye izikhombisi (nje 'enjoy', 'avoid', 'finish') zidinga gerund (-ing), ngakabe ezinye (nje 'want', 'decide', 'hope') zidinga infinitive ne-'to'. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kunezikhombisi eziyiguqula umthelela ngokuthi siyathusa infinitive okanye gerund (ok., 'stop to smoke' vs. 'stop smoking'). Le yiqembu elibalulekile ukukhuluma ngobunye ngesiNgisi.
rule: NgesiNgisi, izikhombisi ezimsuka ziyakhiwa nezinye izikhombisi ngendlela ezimbili: ne-infinitive edulandwa 'to' (I want to go) okanye ne-gerund (-ing) (I enjoy going). Ukhetha kulingana nesikhombisi esingumsuka. Umlingo okuhlekisa: - Izikhombisi eziyithatha infinitive: want, need, decide, hope, plan, promise, agree, offer, forget, learn, n.a. - Izikhombisi eziyithatha gerund: enjoy, finish, avoid, mind, consider, suggest, practice, admit, deny, n.a. - Izikhombisi eziyithatha bobabili ngokungaguquli umthelela: start, begin, continue, like, love, hate, prefer. - Izikhombisi eziyiguqula umthelela: remember, forget, stop, try, regret. (Ok., 'Remember to lock the door' = khumbula ukufakaza; 'Remember locking the door' = uyakhumbula ukufakaza). Qaphela: nezihombisi zokubona nakha 'make' ne-'let', siyathusa infinitive ngaphandle kwe-'to' (I saw him leave, They made me wait). Ekuhambiseni, 'not' siyekwa phambi kwe-infinitive okanye gerund (I decided not to go, I enjoy not working).

concept_examples.text: I want to learn English.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɒnt tə lɜːn ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ/

concept_examples.text: She enjoys reading novels.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃiː ɪnˈdʒɔɪz ˈriːdɪŋ ˈnɒvəlz/

concept_examples.text: We decided to move to London.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wiː dɪˈsaɪdɪd tə muːv tə ˈlʌndən/

concept_examples.text: They avoid driving during rush hour.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ əˈvɔɪd ˈdraɪvɪŋ ˈdjʊərɪŋ rʌʃ ˈaʊə/

common_error.explanation: Isiphambano siphambana ngenxa yokuthi ngesiSulu, 'disfrutar' siyakhiwa ne-infinitive ('disfruta leer'), kodwa ngesiNgisi 'enjoy' ngisho ne-gerund (-ing). Akukho umlingo owenziwe; kufanele ukhumbule ukuthi izikhombisi eziyidinga uphi uhambo. Inhloso ngukufunda izikhombisi ezipopile eziyidinga gerund (enjoy, finish, avoid, n.a.) nezaziidinga infinitive (want, decide, n.a.).

examples.original: I need to buy some milk.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ niːd tə baɪ sʌm mɪlk/
examples.note: Khumbula ukuthi ngesiNgisi ngisho ne-'to' phambi kwe-infinitive, ngaphandle kwezikhombisi eziyingozi (can, must, n.a.).

examples.original: She hopes to pass the exam.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː həʊps tə pɑːs ði ɪɡˈzæm/
examples.note: 'Hope' siyathusa ne-infinitive, hhayi ne-gerund. NgesiSulu sithi 'esperar + infinitive', kodwa ngesiNgisi kufanele ukhumbule 'to'.

examples.original: They plan to travel next summer.
examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ plæn tə ˈtrævl nekst ˈsʌmə/
examples.note: Uthusa 'to' emva kwe-'plan'. Ungasho 'plan travel'.

examples.original: I finish working at five.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˈfɪnɪʃ ˈwɜːkɪŋ æt faɪv/
examples.note: 'Finish' ngisho ne-gerund, hhayi ne-infinitive. NgesiSulu siyathusa 'terminar de + infinitive'.

examples.original: He suggested going to the beach.
examples.phonetic: /hiː səˈdʒestɪd ˈɡəʊɪŋ tə ðə biːtʃ/
examples.note: Emva kwe-'suggest' siyathusa gerund. Yeka isiphambano esikhuluma: 'suggest to go'.

examples.original: Do you mind closing the window?
examples.phonetic: /duː juː maɪnd ˈkləʊzɪŋ ðə ˈwɪndəʊ/
examples.note: 'Mind' siyathusa ne-gerund. NgesiSulu ngingu-'importar + infinitive'.

examples.original: I stopped to smoke because I was tired.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ stɒpt tə sməʊk bɪˈkɒz aɪ wɒz ˈtaɪəd/
examples.note: 'Stop + infinitive' kutsho ukuthi uyamukela ukwenza into enye.

examples.original: I stopped smoking last year.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ stɒpt ˈsməʊkɪŋ lɑːst jɪə/
examples.note: 'Stop + gerund' kutsho ukuthi awukwenzanga loo njalo. Yiyiqembu elibalulekile.

examples.original: Remember to call your mom tonight.
examples.phonetic: /rɪˈmembə tə kɔːl jɔː mɒm təˈnaɪt/
examples.note: 'Remember + infinitive' kutsho ukukhumbula umsebenzi ongazokwenzeka esikhathini esizayo.

examples.original: I remember calling her yesterday.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ rɪˈmembə ˈkɔːlɪŋ hɜː ˈjestədeɪ/
examples.note: 'Remember + gerund' siyathusa ukukhumbula into eyadlule. NgesiSulu siyathusa 'recordar + haber + participio' okanye 'recordar + que + verbo'.

title: Articles Advanced: Zero Article and Generic Use / Izincazelo Eziphelele: Incazelo Eyisikhashana Nokusetshenziswa Okungaphakeme
bridge: NgisiZulu, ngokuvamile siye saqhubeka isihloko esiqondile ukukhuluma ngokuvamile ngento (ngokwesibonelo, 'Izintombazane ziyabonga'). NgesiNgisi, njengaleso sfungo awusetshenziswa lutho: 'Dogs are loyal'. Le yindlela ephulaphulwa ngabantu abakhuluma isiZulu: uyakuthi 'The dogs are loyal' ngesiNgisi, okulesha ukuthi uyakhuluma ngamavukuthu amaningi. NgesiNgisi, awusetshenziswa isihloko nezinhlobo zezinkwa ngokuvamile ('I like rice'), ngakho-ke ngisiZulu ngokuvamile siyasetshenzisa isihloko ('I like the rice').
rule: NgesiNgisi, kunezindaba ezintathu eziphamba 'isihloko esikhashana': 1) Ukukhuluma ngento ngokuvamile nezincazelo ezinaningi okanye ezingabaqediwe (ngokwesibonelo, 'Cats are cute', 'Water is essential'). 2) Nezinhlobo zezinkwa, ulimi, imidlalo nemigaqo yosukelwa lapho azikhethekile (ngokwesibonelo, 'I speak English', 'She plays tennis'). 3) Nezindawo ezifana ne'school', 'hospital', 'church', 'prison' lapho sikhumbuza indlela yokusetshenziswa yazo (ngokwesibonelo, 'He goes to school' - njengomfundi, hhayi njengomselwa). Isikhala: nezincazelo eziqondile eziqondile, kudingeka isihloko okanye umqondisi, ngisho nangokuvamile (ngokwesibonelo, 'A dog is man's best friend' okanye 'The dog is a loyal animal'). Akusekho ukuthi 'Dog is loyal' ukhombisa wonke amavukuthu. Ngaphandle kwalokho, ngesiNgisi awusetshenziswa 'the' nezinhlobo zezizwe ezingenakho izigaba zokwemvumi (ngokwesibonelo, 'Italy', 'Spain'), kodwa kudingeka nezinhlobo ezifana ne'republic', 'kingdom' okanye 'states' (ngokwesibonelo, 'the United States').

concept_examples.text: Cats are independent animals.
concept_examples.phonetic: /kæts ɑːr ˌɪndɪˈpendənt ˈænɪməlz/

concept_examples.text: I love coffee in the morning.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ lʌv ˈkɒfi ɪn ðə ˈmɔːrnɪŋ/

concept_examples.text: She plays tennis on weekends.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃiː pleɪz ˈtenɪs ɒn ˈwiːkendz/

concept_examples.text: Life is full of surprises.
concept_examples.phonetic: /laɪf ɪz fʊl əv sərˈpraɪzɪz/

common_error.explanation: NgesiZulu, sithi 'ubomi buyagcina izimpethu' nesiso esiqondile ngoba sikhumbuza ubomi ngokuvamile. NgesiNgisi, lapho sikhumbuza izincazelo eziqondile ngokuvamile (ubomi, uthando, ukusaba), sisetshenzisa isihloko esikhashana. Ukuthi 'The life' kukhombisa ubomi obutheke ngokwenye indlela, njengokuthi 'the life of a star'. Isibopho sithi: nezincazelo eziqondile okanye eziqondile, awusetshenziswa 'the' uma akukho isimo esiqondile.

levels.label: Zero Article with Plural and Uncountable Nouns
levels.translation: Isihloko esikhashana nezincazelo ezinaningi nezincazelo eziqondile

examples.original: Dogs are loyal friends.
examples.phonetic: /dɒgz ɑːr ˈlɔɪəl frendz/
examples.note: Lapha 'Dogs' sikhumbuza izintombazane ngokuvamile, ngakho-ke awusidinga isihloko. NgesiZulu, siyasetshenzisa 'izintombazane'.

examples.original: Happiness comes from within.
examples.phonetic: /ˈhæpinəs kʌmz frɒm wɪˈðɪn/
examples.note: Izincazelo eziqondile njengokuthi 'happiness' azidingi isihloko lapho zingaphakeme.

examples.original: Water is necessary for survival.
examples.phonetic: /ˈwɔːtər ɪz ˈnesəsəri fɔːr sərˈvaɪvəl/
examples.note: Izincazelo eziqondile njengokuthi 'water' azidingi 'the' ngokuvamile.

levels.label: Zero Article with Meals, Languages, Sports, and Subjects
levels.translation: Isihloko esikhashana nezinkwa, ulimi, imidlalo nemigaqo

examples.original: I have breakfast at seven.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ˈbrekfəst æt ˈsevən/
examples.note: NgesiNgisi, awusekho ukuthi 'a breakfast' okanye 'the breakfast' lapho sikhumbuza ukudla ngokuvamile. NgesiZulu, ngokuvamile siyasetshenzisa isihloko: 'ukudla ekuseni'.

examples.original: They speak Spanish in Peru.
examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ spiːk ˈspænɪʃ ɪn pəˈruː/
examples.note: Ulimi awudingi isihloko ngesiNgisi, ngokungalungile ngesiZulu lapho sithi 'isiZulu'.

examples.original: Football is popular in Europe.
examples.phonetic: /ˈfʊtbɔːl ɪz ˈpɒpjʊlər ɪn ˈjʊərəp/
examples.note: Imidlalo awudingi isihloko. NgesiZulu, sithi 'isokwini'.

levels.label: Zero Article with Institutions and Fixed Phrases

examples.original: He goes to school by bus.
examples.phonetic: /hiː ɡəʊz tə skuːl baɪ bʌs/
examples.note: Awudingi isihloko lapho sisetshenzisa 'school' ukuba sikhumbuze ukufunda. Uma uya ukuze abone, uyakuthi 'to the school'.

examples.original: She is in hospital after the accident.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː ɪz ɪn ˈhɒspɪtl ˈɑːftə ði ˈæksɪdənt/
examples.note: NgesiNgisi yaseNingizimu Afrika, 'in hospital' kukhombisa ukuba uhambile edokotela. NgesiNgisi yaseMelika, sisetshenzisa 'in the hospital' nakuba uhambile edokotela.

examples.original: They go to church every Sunday.
examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ ɡəʊ tə tʃɜːtʃ ˈevri ˈsʌndeɪ/
examples.note: Ukuba uhambe ekhulisweni, awudingi isihloko. Uma uhambe ukuze ubone indlu, uyakuthi 'to the church'.

examples.original: We went to bed early.
examples.phonetic: /wiː went tə bed ˈɜːli/
examples.note: Izincazelo eziqondile njengokuthi 'go to bed', 'go to work', 'at home' awudingi isihloko.
